text: Pirate ship scene. Background: a light cyan rectangle, 780 by 480, in the center, background layer, named Sky.
the sea: a blue rectangle zone, 780 by 160, at the bottom, named Ocean
Ship hull: a large brown rectangle named Hull in the center
move it down 90
Mast: a brown rectangle 12 wide and 180 tall right above Hull, no gap, named Mast
a big white sail: large white square named Sail left of Mast, 20 px away
black flag: small black triangle just 2 px above Mast, called Flag
write "X" on the flag
three tiny gold circles in a row at 400,340 for portholes
group Hull, Mast, Sail, Flag and the three portholes as Ship
Island on the right: a large yellow ellipse named Island in the bottom right
palm tree: a brown rectangle, 14 by 70, named Trunk right above Island, no gap
and a medium green star 3 px above Trunk for the leaves, named PalmTop
treasure chest on the island: small orange square named Chest left of Trunk, 16 px gap
group Island, Trunk, PalmTop and Chest as Isle
dotted arrow from Flag to Chest, label it "X marks the spot"
Is Chest right of Hull?
